distribution: 云南（陇川章凤、元江红光农场）；国外见于缅甸、泰国、马来亚、新加坡与印度。
en: The Chinese termite volume lists Coptotermes gestroi from Zhangfeng in Longchuan and the Hongguang farm at Yuanjiang, Yunnan, and from Burma, Thailand, Malaya, Singapore and India, but gives no description of the soldier, the alate or the worker. Recognition therefore depends on the genus, whose soldiers have sabre-shaped mandibles and a frontal gland opening on a short tube, and whose alates show a reticulate wing membrane.
